ninth.definition: The person or thing in the ninth position.

nodded.definition: To incline the head up and down, as to indicate agreement.

nomination.definition: An act or instance of nominating.

nook.definition: A small corner formed by two walls; an alcove.

noon.definition: The ninth hour of the day counted from sunrise; around three o'clock in the afternoon.

notation.definition: The act, process, method, or an instance of representing by a system or set of marks, signs, figures, or characters.

notion.definition: Mental apprehension of whatever may be known, thought, or imagined; idea, concept.

nought.definition: Nothing; something which does not exist.

oath.definition: A solemn pledge or promise, appealing to a deity, a ruler, or another entity (not necessarily present) to attest to the truth of a statement or sincerity of one's desire to fulfill a contract or promise.

octal.definition: The number system that uses the eight digits 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.

oddly.definition: In a peculiar manner; strangely; unusually.

offend.definition: To hurt the feelings of; to displease; to make angry; to insult.

offended.definition: To hurt the feelings of; to displease; to make angry; to insult.

oilcloth.definition: A fabric or cloth treated on one side with a waterproof covering, especially one made from linseed oil etc.; used for flooring, tablecloths, kitchen shelves and sometimes furniture covering.

oink.definition: The sound made by a pig, or an imitation thereof.

oinking.definition: Of a pig or in imitation thereof, to make its characteristic sound.

olio.definition: A rich, thick, Spanish stew consisting of meat and vegetables.

onion.definition: A monocotyledonous plant (Allium cepa), allied to garlic, used as vegetable and spice.

optima.definition: The best or most favorable condition, or the greatest amount or degree possible under specific sets of comparable circumstances.

outthought.definition: To best an opponent by thinking.

owed.definition: To be under an obligation to give something back to someone or to perform some action for someone.

owned.definition: To have rightful possession of (property, goods or capital); to have legal title to.

palm.definition: Any of various evergreen trees from the family Palmae or Arecaceae, which are mainly found in the tropics.

penmen.definition: A scribe, or person who copies texts

pimp.definition: Someone who solicits customers for prostitution and acts as manager for a group of prostitutes; a pander.

pimped.definition: To act as a procurer of prostitutes; to pander.

pimping.definition: To act as a procurer of prostitutes; to pander.

rabbi.definition: A Jewish scholar or teacher of halacha (Jewish law), capable of making halachic decisions.

rabbit.definition: A mammal of the family Leporidae, with long ears, long hind legs and a short, fluffy tail.

rack.definition: A series of one or more shelves, stacked one above the other

raita.definition: A condiment used as a dip or sauce in the cuisine of southern Asia, made from seasoned yogurt.

ribbit.definition: The vocal sound made by a frog or toad.

robot.definition: A machine built to carry out some complex task or group of tasks by physically moving, especially one which can be programmed.

tabard.definition: A silk banner attached to a bugle or trumpet.

taboo.definition: An inhibition or ban that results from social custom or emotional aversion.

tacit.definition: Expressed in silence; implied, but not made explicit; silent.

tack.definition: A small nail with a flat head.

taco.definition: A Mexican snack food; a small tortilla (soft or hard shelled), with typically some type of meat, rice, beans, cheese, diced vegetables (usually tomatoes and lettuce, as served in the United States, and cilantro, onion, and avocado, as served in México) and salsa.

tactic.definition: A maneuver, or action calculated to achieve some end.

tactician.definition: A person skilled in the planning and execution of tactics.

tailcoat.definition: A formal evening jacket with an extended back panel; a dress coat.

taint.definition: A contamination, decay or putrefaction, especially in food

tamp.definition: (blasting) To plug up with clay, earth, dry sand, sod, or other material, as a hole bored in a rock.

tannic.definition: Pertaining to, containing, or obtained from tannin.

tannin.definition: Tannic acid or any of its derivatives.

tart.definition: Sharp to the taste; acid; sour.

tartar.definition: A red compound deposited during wine making; mostly potassium hydrogen tartrate - a source of cream of tartar.

tatami.definition: Straw matting, in a standard size, used as a floor covering in Japanese houses

tattoo.definition: An image made in the skin with ink and a needle.

teeth.definition: The ability to be enforced, or to be enforced to any useful effect.

tenth.definition: The person or thing coming next after the ninth in a series; that which is in the tenth position.

that.definition: Something being indicated that is there; one of those.

thatch.definition: Straw, rushes, or similar, used for making or covering the roofs of buildings, or of stacks of hay or grain.

thee.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun thee.

then.definition: Used in comparisons, to introduce the basis of comparison.

thin.definition: A loss or tearing of paper from the back of a stamp, although not sufficient to create a complete hole.

thought.definition: To ponder, to go over in one's head.

thug.definition: Someone with an intimidating and unseemly appearance and mannerisms, who treats others violently and roughly, often for hire.

till.definition: Until; to, up to; as late as (a given time).

tinny.definition: Of or pertaining to or resembling tin.

titan.definition: Something or someone of very large stature, greatness, or godliness.

titanic.definition: Having great size, or great strength, force or power.

titivating.definition: To make small improvements or alterations to (one's appearance etc.); to add some finishing touches to.

toccata.definition: A piece of music (usually for a keyboard instrument) designed to emphasise the dexterity of the performer.

toil.definition: Labour, work, especially of a grueling nature.

toll.definition: Loss or damage incurred through a disaster.

tomatillo.definition: A plant of the nightshade family originating in Mexico, Physalis philadelphica, cultivated for its tomato-like green to green-purple fruit surrounded by a thin papery skin.

tomtit.definition: Petroica macrocephala, the miromiro or New Zealand tit, a bird of the Petroicidae (Australasian robin) family.

tool.definition: A mechanical device intended to make a task easier.

toot.definition: The noise of a horn or whistle.

tooth.definition: A hard, calcareous structure present in the mouth of many vertebrate animals, generally used for eating.

total.definition: An amount obtained by the addition of smaller amounts.

tough.definition: A person who obtains things by force; a thug or bully.

track.definition: A mark left by something that has passed along.

trait.definition: An identifying characteristic, habit or trend.

trick.definition: Something designed to fool or swindle.

troubadour.definition: An itinerant composer and performer of songs in medieval Europe; a jongleur or travelling minstrel.

tuba.definition: A large brass musical instrument, usually in the bass range, played through a vibration of the lips upon the mouthpiece and fingering of the keys.

turbot.definition: A species of flatfish native to Europe (Scophthalmus maximus, earlier Psetta maxima).

unfed.definition: A mosquito that has not had a blood meal.

unfenced.definition: Not enclosed by a fence or other boundary; free to roam over a wider area.

unfounded.definition: Having no strong foundation; not based on solid reasons or facts.

unfunded.definition: Not funded; having received no funding.

unhung.definition: (of a person) Not (yet) executed by hanging; unhanged.

unthought.definition: To undo the process of thinking.

vagal.definition: Of or relating to the vagus nerve.

vagina.definition: The passage leading from the opening of the vulva to the cervix of the uterus for copulation and childbirth in female mammals.

vaginal.definition: Of, relating to, or affecting the vagina.

vain.definition: Overly proud of oneself, especially concerning appearance; having a high opinion of one's own accomplishments with slight reason.

valiant.definition: A person who acts with valor, showing hero-like characteristics in the midst of danger.

vanilla.definition: Any tropical, climbing orchid of the genus Vanilla (especially Vanilla planifolia), bearing podlike fruit yielding an extract used in flavoring food or in perfumes.

vanillin.definition: A chemical compound, 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde, that is the primary constituent of vanilla.

vanity.definition: That which is vain, futile, or worthless; that which is of no value, use or profit.

vial.definition: A glass vessel or bottle, especially a small tube-shaped bottle used to store medicine, perfume or other chemical.

vicinity.definition: Proximity; the state of being near.

vigil.definition: An instance of keeping awake during normal sleeping hours, especially to keep watch or pray.

vigilant.definition: Watchful, especially for danger or disorder; alert; wary

viking.definition: One of the Scandinavian or other Northern European seafaring warriors that raided (and then settled) the British Isles and other parts of Europe in the 8th to the 11th centuries and, according to many historians, were the first Europeans to reach North America.

villa.definition: (plural "villas") A house, often larger and more expensive than average, in the countryside or on the coast, often used as a retreat.

vital.definition: Relating to, or characteristic of life.

vitiating.definition: To spoil, make faulty; to reduce the value, quality, or effectiveness of something

vivacity.definition: The quality or state of being vivacious.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

woody.definition: An early station wagon or estate car in which the rear portion of the car's bodywork is made of wood, often associated with Southern California surfing culture.

yahoo.definition: A rough, coarse, loud or uncouth person; yokel; lout.

zinnia.definition: Any of several brightly coloured flowering plants, of the genus Zinnia, native to tropical America; old maid

ziti.definition: A type of penne pasta in the form of long smooth hollow tubes.
